name: The Hero gives up! ... Wait, what!?
source:
In this Visual Novel follow the story of the newly appointed, against his will, Hero! Meet new companions and together face the Demon Lord!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2558980/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在这部视觉小说中，讲述了新任命的英雄的故事，这违背了他的意愿！结识新伙伴，一起对抗魔王！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2558980/]Steam[/url]]
